# `enrichers/prism.ts`

## Overview

This module provides a Prism-based enricher that augments data with relevant code references, module summaries, and analytical findings. It exports the core enricher instance along with the TypeScript interfaces that describe the shape of the enriched output.

---

## Interfaces

### `PrismRelevantCode`

Represents a single relevant code result returned by the Prism enricher.

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `targetId` | `string` | Identifier of the target this code is associated with. |
| `filePath` | `string \| null` | Path to the source file, or `null` if unavailable. |
| `symbolName` | `string \| null` | Name of the relevant symbol, or `null` if unavailable. |
| `symbolKind` | `string \| null` | Kind/type of the symbol (e.g., function, class), or `null` if unavailable. |
| `level` | `string` | Relevance level of the code result. |
| `summary` | `string` | Human-readable summary of the relevant code. |
| `score` | `number` | Relevance score assigned to this result. |

---

### `PrismModuleSummary`

Represents a summary generated for a specific module or target.

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `targetId` | `string` | Identifier of the module or target being summarized. |
| `content` | `string` | The text content of the module summary. |

---

### `PrismFinding`

Represents a single analytical finding produced by the Prism enricher.

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `category` | `string` | Category that the finding belongs to. |
| `severity` | `string` | Severity level of the finding (e.g., error, warning, info). |
| `title` | `string` | Short title describing the finding. |
| `description` | `string` | Detailed description of the finding. |
| `suggestion` | `string \| null` | Suggested remediation or action, or `null` if none provided. |

---

### `PrismEnrichmentData`

The top-level data structure containing all enrichment output produced by the Prism enricher.

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `relevantCode` | `PrismRelevantCode[]` | Array of relevant code results. |
| `moduleSummaries` | `PrismModuleSummary[]` | Array of module summaries. |
| `findings` | `PrismFinding[]` | Array of analytical findings. |
| `stats` | `object` | Aggregate statistics for the enrichment run (see below). |

#### `stats` Object

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `searchResults` | `number` | Total number of search results returned. |
| `summariesReturned` | `number` | Number of module summaries returned. |
| `findingsReturned` | `number` | Number of findings returned. |

---

## Exported Constants

### `prismEnricher`

**Type:** `Enricher`

The primary enricher instance for the Prism module. Use this to integrate Prism-based enrichment into a processing pipeline.

```typescript
import { prismEnricher } from './enrichers/prism';

// Register or invoke the enricher within your pipeline
pipeline.register(prismEnricher);
```
